text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I see something prominent in the<n>distance, almost
like a flash of light.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's someone running. She's too far<n>for me to
make out her face, yet<n>somehow I can hear the
deep rhythm<n>of her breaths.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her strides are chaotic and<n>shuddering with
desperation. But I<n>sense pride as well. It's as if
she's<n>fearlessly leading the way forward,<n>like...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without even knowing her name or<n>face, I'm
compelled to see her run<n>one more time. Later, I try
searching<n>for her identity...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But it's to no avail. Months go by,<n>and I can't even
find the first letter of<n>her name.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After searching so long in vain for a<n>hero, I feel a
desire to read an epic<n>tale. I scour the library for an
inspiring<n>biographical story... but can't seem to<n>find
any.
Ah... Pardon me. Are you having any<n>trouble?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm Zenno Rob Roy. I'm the library<n>assistant. I
just... If there's a book<n>you're trying to find, I
thought maybe<n>I could... assist?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! B-but if I'm interrupting, please<n>accept my
apologies!
choice_data_list:
Actually, could you tell me where the biographies
are?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The biographies! Yes, they're rather<n>difficult to find,
aren't they? You see,<n>they're not actually found
under<n>"history," they're in the same section<n>as
novels and essays.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you understand,<n>biographies often
include a healthy<n>dose of fiction. That's why
they're<n>separated from the history books, so<n>people
don't just take them for fact.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but personally, I love the ones that<n>incorporate
lots of fiction! When<n>people elevate stories into
legends, it<n>just proves how highly the subjects<n>are
regarded!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Individuals so beloved that their tales<n>live on in
everyone's<n>memories—that's the true mark of a
hero! It's why I...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I believe that's when a person truly<n>becomes a
hero! When their life's<n>story is passed down as an
epic tale!
choice_data_list: You really like stories about heroes, huh?
You really like stories about heroes, huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah! Um, no... Not really... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I didn't intend to become<n>overexcited... So... you can
find the<n>biographies over there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And... I'm sorry again. Excuse me<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly she seems deflated... She<n>claims she
doesn't really like heroic<n>tales, but her enthusiasm
when<n>speaking of them says otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Why did she deny it though? As I<n>head to the
section she directed me<n>to, I can't help but wonder
how she<n>really feels.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I pick a book and read through a good<n>chunk of it.
There's certainly a fair<n>amount of fiction, but even
so, it's<n>quite the epic!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A person's tale only becomes a<n>heroic epic... when
their story is<n>passed down as legend.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But my story is still... No, if I really<n>think about it... I'll
never...
choice_data_list: I'd like to check this one out, please!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Certainly! One book to check out.<n>Oh, this is...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Do you... like heroic stories?
choice_data_list:
Kind of. I was inspired by watching a heroic
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I explain all about my vivid memory of<n>the runner I
saw and how I've been<n>searching for her ever
since.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A heroic Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A performance so amazing it felt like<n>that of a
legendary hero, even just<n>seeing it from afar...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That must mean at this very moment...<n>there's a
student of that caliber at<n>Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, sorry... I know we've only just<n>met, and this
is most definitely asking<n>too much, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Would you let me... help you find your<n>hero?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm good at finding information, and I<n>know all
about heroes! I'm certain<n>that I can be of use!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As much as I'd love to accept,<n>students at Tracen
need to focus on<n>their training.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I ask if this little mission of mine<n>won't interfere
with her training at all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'll be fine! I can do both! I... I<n>really want to
know. I need to find out<n>why you thought that
runner was so<n>heroic.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I just... I have to. Because...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uh, nothing! Either way, I'm sure this<n>will prove to
be of benefit to me as<n>well. Thanks for
understanding!
